summary.en: Suggestions from plugins (@github) and script extensions are on by default; Trust its updates turns a source's suggestions back on; in Slack and other Chromium apps, ⏎ on a Markdown-link row no longer sends the message.
summary.zh: 插件（@github）和脚本扩展的建议默认打开；打开「信任它的更新」会把那个来源的建议重新打开；在 Slack 等 Chromium 系 App 里，对 Markdown 链接的行按 ⏎ 不再把消息发出去。
